pllsim v0.4.0 — GUI: the browser workbench

Highlights since v0.3.0:

- Streamlit GUI covering every capability (pip install -e .[gui];
  streamlit run gui/Home.py), bilingual zh/EN, 11 pages:
  * architecture workbench: preset -> auto-generated forms for EVERY
    Config field (units annotated, calibrators rebuilt fresh per run)
    -> analyze()/simulate() with the full plot set (PN breakdown +
    periodogram overlay, transients, calibration traces, spur tables)
  * loop synthesis (CP/SSPLL filters, ADPLL DLF, bandwidth sweep)
  * architecture selector (requirement form -> 7-architecture ranking)
  * deterministic spur prediction (INL/gain what-ifs, worst-channel sweep)
  * measured-PN fitting (CSV upload -> Leeson / closed-loop / budget
    attribution; built-in synthetic demo data)
  * two-point GMSK modulation EVM, hop settling (live FLL-stability
    check), drift tracking, Monte Carlo yield, VAMS export with zip
    download, four-paper benchmark table with live re-run
- pllsim.guiutil: GUI-support introspection with no streamlit
  dependency (dataclass tree -> annotated field specs -> overrides with
  calibrator rebuild), unit-tested standalone; picklable Monte Carlo
  build factory for the process pool
- CI runs the whole GUI headless via streamlit AppTest (14 smoke tests;
  skipped automatically where streamlit is absent)
- Suite at 150 tests
